Notes: Values from weapon_<gun>.vdata. Damage falls off as damage * RangeModifier^(units/500), the CS convention documented at counterstrike.fandom.com/wiki/Damage_dropoff and steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2599082552 - community documentation of the formula, not the SDK source. Spread is atan(m_flSpread + m_flInaccuracy*) in degrees, a reading of the units. Recoil ratios are CS2's; the absolute degrees-per-recoil-unit scale is anchored to the AK's previously hand-fitted 1.6 deg and is ESTIMATED.
